en_title: Avengers: Endgame Encore Leaks Reveal New Ending and Additional Scenes That Connect to Avengers: Doomsday, Including Several Unannounced Cast Members
cn_title: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》重映版片段泄露
subtitle: 复联4再掀波澜
opus_summary: 《复仇者联盟：终局之战》重映版新增四段画面遭到泄露，其中包括改动后的结局，以及布鲁斯·班纳、洛基和毁灭博士等角色的片段。这些内容进一步连接《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，影片将于12月18日上映。

paragraphs.en: Four new scenes included in Avengers: Endgame Encore have leaked online, including a tweaked ending to the 2019 Marvel blockbuster.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：终局之战》重映版包含的四段新场景已在网上泄露，其中包括对这部2019年漫威大片结局的改动。

paragraphs.en: These additional extras have been designed to link Endgame directly to the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday, and also to encourage theatregoers to rewatch the last Avengers film all over again to swell Marvel's coffers - er, I mean, to prep themselves for what's next.
paragraphs.cn: 这些新增内容旨在将《终局之战》与即将上映的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》直接联系起来，同时也鼓励观众再次走进影院重温上一部《复仇者联盟》电影，为接下来的故事做好准备。当然，也是为了让漫威赚得盆满钵满——呃，我是说，为接下来的内容做好准备。

paragraphs.en: Warning! Spoilers for Avengers: Endgame Encore follow:
paragraphs.cn: 警告！以下内容涉及《复仇者联盟：终局之战》重映版剧透：

paragraphs.en: Inevitably, footage has emerged from early screenings of Avengers: Endgame Encore showing the new scenes in full, which Marvel is now scrambling to scrub from social media. However, IGN has reviewed numerous copies of the scenes today before they were deleted from X/Twitter via copyright claim — thereby confirming their legitimacy.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，《复仇者联盟：终局之战》重映版早期放映中的画面已经流出，完整展示了这些新增场景。漫威目前正忙着从社交媒体上清除相关内容。不过，IGN今天在这些片段因版权投诉从X上删除前，已经查看了多个版本，从而确认了它们的真实性。

paragraphs.en: Most notably, the scenes include multiple characters whose appearance in Doomsday had not previously been revealed. Since these extra moments are believed to have been filmed during Doomsday's production, it's now likely we'll be seeing more of these characters in December, when Doomsday itself arrives.
paragraphs.cn: 最值得注意的是，这些场景中出现了多名此前尚未公布会在《毁灭之日》中登场的角色。由于这些额外片段据称是在《毁灭之日》制作期间拍摄的，因此这些角色很可能会在12月影片上映时再次出现。

paragraphs.en: The first extra scene acts as a new ending to Endgame, and merges directly with the pre-existing finale that fans already know and love: Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter reunited, sharing a dance, and settling down to a quiet life together.
paragraphs.cn: 第一段新增场景成为《终局之战》的新结局，并与粉丝熟悉且喜爱的原结局直接衔接：史蒂夫·罗杰斯与佩吉·卡特重逢，共舞一曲，随后共同过上平静的生活。

paragraphs.en: Except the couple's quiet moment together is now interrupted by a knock at their door. Cautiously, Peggy opens it to reveal Loki, who greets the couple, as Steve looks surprised.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这对情侣共度的宁静时光如今被敲门声打断。佩吉谨慎地打开房门，发现门外站着洛基。洛基向两人打招呼，史蒂夫则露出了惊讶的表情。

paragraphs.en: A few things here are immediately obvious — this is the version of Loki who has joined the TVA (the Time Variance Authority, essentially Marvel's multiverse police) but before he ends up becoming the all-powerful replacement of Kang. All of this fits with long-held leaked information that suggests Loki moves Steve and Peggy (and their son) to another branch of the multiverse for their own protection, several years before the main events of Doomsday take place.
paragraphs.cn: 这里有几件事很快就能看出来：这是已经加入TVA的洛基，也就是时间变异管理局，基本相当于漫威多元宇宙中的警察；但此时的他还没有成为取代康的全能存在。所有这些内容都与流传已久的泄露信息相吻合。相关消息称，洛基会为了保护史蒂夫、佩吉以及他们的儿子，将他们带到多元宇宙的另一条分支，而这一切发生在《毁灭之日》主要事件展开前数年。

paragraphs.en: During Endgame Encore's credits, the first all-new scene features Mark Ruffalo as Bruce Banner (and briefly, off-screen, the Hulk). This appears to be our first confirmation that the character will indeed appear in Avengers: Doomsday, after last being seen in bad shape at the end of Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
paragraphs.cn: 在《终局之战》重映版的片尾字幕期间，第一段全新场景出现了马克·鲁法洛饰演的布鲁斯·班纳，以及短暂在画外出现的浩克。这似乎首次确认了该角色确实会出现在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中。我们上一次看到他时，他在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》结尾处的状态并不好。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, this scene picks up a little while after Hulk is taken away, seemingly out of action following a destructive stint as his green alter ego. Now secluded in an old military bunker two miles underground, Banner records a video where he begins to discuss his work creating a new stabilizing serum. And, of course, he states that no one can get into the bunker to disturb.
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，这段场景发生在浩克被带走后不久。当时，他似乎因为以绿色另一个自我的身份造成破坏而暂时无法行动。如今，班纳躲在地下两英里深处的一座旧军事掩体中，录制了一段视频，并开始谈论自己研发新型稳定血清的工作。当然，他还表示没有人能进入这座掩体打扰他。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, his video (and his work on that serum) are interrupted by the arrival of Doctor Doom into the bunker to disturb him. While kept offscreen, we hear Robert Downey Jr's voice say that he's come to "collect" Banner, as the scientist seemingly morphs into the Hulk once more. Has Doom enslaved Hulk, or sought to absorb his power somehow? We'll have to wait and see.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，毁灭博士进入掩体并打扰班纳，打断了他的视频以及血清研究。虽然毁灭博士没有出现在画面中，但我们听到小罗伯特·唐尼的声音表示，他是来「带走」班纳的。与此同时，这名科学家似乎再次变身为浩克。毁灭博士是奴役了浩克，还是试图以某种方式吸收他的力量？我们只能拭目以待。

paragraphs.en: The next all-new scene is set within the TVA, presumably in the time after Loki has ascended to godhood. His former colleagues Mobius (Owen Wilson), Casey (Eugene Cordero) and Ouroboros (Ke Huy Quan) all panic as they spot a pair of Earths from different universes about to collide, and which begin to attack each other. One of these Earths is Universe-1005, the Fox X-Men universe, which ties into long-held leaks that the mutant team has been surviving incursions by wiping out other universes first. (I sure hope they don't have to destroy a universe with any other beloved Marvel character in!)
paragraphs.cn: 下一段全新场景发生在TVA内部，时间点大概是在洛基成神之后。他的前同事莫比乌斯（欧文·威尔逊）、凯西（Eugene Cordero）和Ouroboros（Ke Huy Quan）发现来自不同宇宙的两颗地球即将相撞，并开始互相攻击后，全都陷入恐慌。其中一颗地球属于1005号宇宙，也就是福克斯《X战警》宇宙。这与流传已久的泄露消息相呼应：为了在入侵中存活下来，这支变种人队伍一直会先摧毁其他宇宙。（我真希望他们不用摧毁一个还有其他漫威经典角色存在的宇宙！）

paragraphs.en: Things quickly get worse, however, as the TVA team quickly realizes that the entire multiverse is collapsing, with thousands of universes now at risk of being annihilated through incursions.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，事态很快进一步恶化。TVA团队意识到，整个多元宇宙正在崩溃，数千个宇宙都有可能在入侵中被毁灭。

paragraphs.en: While some involvement of the TVA in Doomsday seemed likely, none of these characters have previously been confirmed to return for the film. Indeed, none have been seen since the finale of Loki, which wrapped up in 2023. Tara Strong's animated Miss Minutes also features here, too.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管TVA参与《毁灭之日》似乎早已在意料之中，但此前从未确认这些角色会回归影片。事实上，自2023年完结的《洛基》大结局以来，他们就再也没有登场过。Tara Strong配音的动画角色分钟小姐也出现在了这段场景中。

paragraphs.en: At the end of Endgame Encore's credits, one final snippet sees Doctor Doom hammering his metal mask into shape. This is a clear and obvious nod to Iron Man (also played by Robert Downey Jr.!) who created his first mask in the same way, and a reference to the original ending of Endgame, which featured the same hammer sounds heard here (which come from the first 2008 Iron Man film).
paragraphs.cn: 在《终局之战》重映版片尾字幕的最后，一段片段展示了毁灭博士敲打金属面具，将其塑造成型。这显然是在致敬《钢铁侠》，同样由小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的托尼·斯塔克当年也用同样的方式制作了自己的第一副面具。同时，这也是对《终局之战》原版结局的呼应，因为那里也出现了与此处相同的锤击声，而这段声音来自2008年的首部《钢铁侠》电影。

paragraphs.en: Maybe the Russos always knew this post-credits tease would eventually be changed to feature Doctor Doom! Or, maybe, this is just a really clever callback.
paragraphs.cn: 也许罗素兄弟早就知道，这段片尾彩蛋最终会被改成由毁灭博士登场！又或者，这只是一次非常巧妙的回溯致敬。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters on December 18, and I'm genuinely more excited to see it after watching all of these. Are you headed to Avengers: Endgame Encore to catch them on the big screen?
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将于12月18日登陆影院。看完这些片段后，我确实更期待这部电影了。你会去影院观看《复仇者联盟：终局之战》重映版，在大银幕上看看这些新增内容吗？
